name: HZ_ORG_CONTACT_ROLES_
description: The HZ_ORG_CONTACT_ROLES table stores information about the role of the contact position that is specified in the HZ_ORG_CONTACTS table. Contacts may have multiple roles. For example, a vice president of manufacturing may have a custom-defined role as a member of a capital expenditures review board.

columns.name: ORG_CONTACT_ROLE_ID
columns.description: Unique contact role identifier. System Generated. Primary Key.

columns.name: ORG_CONTACT_ID
columns.description: Organization contact identifier. Foreign key to the HZ_ORG_CONTACTS table

columns.name: ROLE_TYPE
columns.description: Role performed by a contact

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this is the primary role for this contact. Y for primary role, N for a non-primary role for the contact. The default value is N.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Unique contact identifier from foreign or legacy system

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.
